findings.text: follow-on: the recorded head-arm gate log declares rev 65f1b1d (the base sha) in its header, so the related-batch result it carries cannot be tied to the head commit f60c9416f; the done_when's no-added-failure-against-base claim therefore rests on logs whose head arm is unlabelled.

item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit f60c9416f against base 65f1b1d; it adds promote_review_run_itself, wires it into the review branch of dispatch_awaiting_reviews, widens the review skip from _is_review_node to _is_review_run, records self_promoted and review_self_refused on the sweep result, and adds the review-self value to ledger.py, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_review_run_promotes_itself.py in a temporary crew home and repository plus a logged negative control; the manifest records 4 passed and negative-control.log shows EXIT=1, and I re-ran the gate at HEAD (4 passed) and the recovery_review_acceptance-importing batch (90 passed) green.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a review-role run promotes itself with promoted_by review-self once its manifest is complete, its worker and supervisor have exited, and its stored record parses; reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:248 promote_review_run_itself implements exactly that and the gate run at HEAD passes its four cases.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports the gate 4 passed, related batch 121 passed, negative control EXIT=1, and names head-full.log and head.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's five declared paths; every path in the diff (recovery_review_acceptance.py, ledger.py, test_a_review_run_promotes_itself.py, the fragment) is inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_review_run_promotes_itself.py:207 fails the live-worker case when the exited-worker guard is dropped, shown by negative-control.log EXIT=1, and test_review_role_is_not_reviewed.py:229 fails if the skip reverts to a prefix-only test.
justifications.evidence: the gate is real and green at HEAD, but both run-directory logs name rev 65f1b1d (the base) on head-full.log:1, so the head arm's revision is not recorded and a reader cannot confirm which revision its 121 passed measured.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:248 follows the surrounding return-a-refusal-dict idiom and added lines carry no plan label or section reference.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:248 gates promotion on _complete_manifest_write_time, record_process_alive, _run_exit_record and _delivered_review_record exactly as the goal states.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:335 composes the existing promotion.complete call rather than forking a promotion path, and reuses _delivered_review_record, _run_exit_record, record_process_alive and _is_review_run from their owners.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path (reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py, reckon/ledger.py, tests/test_a_review_run_promotes_itself.py, the fragment) is inside the five declared write paths.
